description: This file defines a PHP trait 'SessionHandlingTrait' that provides session management functionality, specifically handling session timeout redirection logic within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for handling session timeouts, session migration, and URL redirections, utilizing various services and traits.

methods.name: handleSessionTimeoutRedirect
methods.description: Handles session timeout by renewing the session and determining if a redirect URL should be returned based on user attributes and predefined login/logout URLs.
